correctness.rationale: At the disease-free equilibrium the continuous infected eigenvalue is negative with magnitude c(1-R0), while direct differentiation of the printed NSFD map gives multiplier (1+c R0 phi)/(1+c phi). Its decomposition as R0+(1-R0)/(1+c phi) proves the strict floor for every finite positive denominator. The crossover and asymptotic-rate statements follow algebraically; symbolic replay verifies them and the exact witness.

value.rationale: The paper advertises dynamic consistency for all step sizes and numerical superiority over competing schemes. The exact crossover identifies where qualitative stability ceases to imply even possible matching of the physical infection-decay multiplier, and the source denominator makes the per-unit-time decay arbitrarily slow for large steps. This is a sharp, interpretable limitation on long-step epidemic time-scale fidelity rather than a generic truncation-error observation.
